Students Protest NEET Issue, Target Abhijit Dipke in Latur

Students protested in Latur against Abhijit Dipke, founder of the 'Cockroach Janata Party', over the NEET issue. Protesters displayed posters and allegedly hit them with footwear, questioning Dipke's silence on the matter. The protests occurred in Latur.
